summary: Dorman Products filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, reporting the issuance of $450 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% senior notes due June 2034. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, guaranteed by certain wholly-owned subsidiaries, and rank pari passu with existing and future senior indebtedness. Interest is payable semi-annually on June 15 and December 15, commencing December 15, 2026. The company may redeem up to 40% of the notes before June 15, 2029, at 106.250% of principal using equity offering proceeds, subject to conditions. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
